title: Expressing Regret with If Only and I Wish + Past Perfect
summary: Page introduces expressing regret using If only or I wish + past perfect, with a driving test report reading, matching sentences with photos, and completing regret sentences for given situations.
section: Lesson 5: I wish I'd brought my sunglasses

title: Practising Regret Sentences with If Only and I Wish
summary: Learners continue writing regrets starting with If only or I wish for six situations, then write two regrets per situation using both structures to reinforce the grammar pattern.

title: Third Conditional Practice: Listening and Matching Career Outcomes
summary: Students listen to a movie director describe failed career attempts, match sentence beginnings with endings, and complete sentences using third conditional forms of given verbs.

title: Completing Third Conditional Sentences with Appropriate Verbs
summary: Learners complete third conditional sentences by choosing correct verb forms, then fill in ten open-ended sentences with suitable verbs in the appropriate third conditional structure.

title: Completing an Accommodation Form and Advertisement
summary: Students fill in a course advertisement with words from a box, listen to check answers, then complete a personal accommodation form using vocabulary such as allergies, details, and dietary requirements.
section: Lesson 7: Learn English in the UK

title: Asking Questions About Courses and Forming Adjectives from Nouns
summary: Learners work in pairs to write questions about courses and accommodation at Birchwood International College, then form adjectives from nouns in brackets to complete descriptive sentences.

title: Completing an Invitation Email About an English Course in Britain
summary: Students complete a template email inviting a friend to join an English course at Birchwood International College, filling in details about duration, location, accommodation, and budget.

title: Writing an Email Inviting a Friend to an English Course Abroad
summary: Writing task asking learners to compose a 100-120 word email to a friend suggesting an English course abroad, covering month, location preferences, accommodation type, and price justification.
